title: Staff Data Engineer
description:
Who we are
 At Twilio , we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.
 Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.
 Hiring and how we work
 We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!
 Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.
 See yourself at Twilio
 Join the team as Twilio’s next Staff Data Engineer.
 About the job
 This position is needed to design, build, and optimize Twilio's next-generation unified data platforms and services to power strategic, data-driven business decisions.
 As a senior technical leader on our Enterprise Data Engineering team, you will drive a massive, highly visible transformation to unify disparate data lakes into a single, high-performance platform. By combining classic dimensional modeling with cutting-edge AI, you will accelerate data delivery at an immense scale. This is your chance to solve complex architectural challenges, mentor rising talent, and directly influence Twilio’s strategic direction.

 In this role, you’ll:
 Architect and scale high-performance data platforms to unify acquired data lakes, improving delivery speed by leveraging AI-driven workflows.

title: [Interim] Senior Analytics Engineer (PowerBI & Databricks)
description:
Job Title: Senior Analytics Engineer
 Location: Leiden, Netherlands (Hybrid: 3 days on-site, 2 remote)
 Engagement: Full-time, 5 days a week
 Contract duration: 3 months + extension
 Start date: ASAP (mid-December preferred, early January at the latest)
 We're looking for a hands-on Senior Analytics Engineer to join one of our client projects and help deliver practical data solutions on Databricks . You'll work at the intersection of data engineering and application development, building simple web applications that let business users view, enter and correct data. You'll also model the data behind them and support analytics in Power BI . This role suits a builder who is comfortable working with business users and turning their needs into working tools.
 What you'll do
 Build data apps – develop simple web applications for data entry, validation and commenting that read from and write back to the lakehouse, replacing manual Excel/CSV uploads and Microsoft Lists.
 Model for insight – design data models and lakehouse tables that keep data trusted, sustainable and easy to connect across use cases.
 Contribute to the ETL life-cycle – build and schedule simple transformation pipelines in Azure Databricks / Spark (SQL and Python), with support from the wider team.
 Apply DataOps/DevOps best practices – version control, CI/CD and promotion of applications and pipelines across development, test and production environments.
 Support analytics – create and maintain Power BI reports alongside the business-facing analytics lead.
 Engage with the business – validate requirements directly with users, and spot when a new request is really a separate use case that should be captured on its own.
 Collaborate on strategy – work together with the Data & Analytics team to align technical choices with the wider data-platform roadmap.
 What you bring
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Senior Data Engineer (w/m/d)
description:
Du möchtest moderne Datenplattformen entwickeln, skalierbare Datenarchitekturen gestalten und die datengetriebene Weiterentwicklung einer wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe aktiv vorantreiben? Dann suchen wir Dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als:
 Senior Data Engineer (w/m/d)
 Als Senior Data Engineer (w/m/d) übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung unserer gruppenweiten Datenplattform. Du entwickelst stabile und skalierbare Datenpipelines, stellst eine hohe Datenqualität sicher und schaffst die technische Grundlage für datenbasierte Entscheidungen. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit unseren Analytics-, Product- und Engineering-Teams zusammen und gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung unserer Datenarchitektur und Datenstrategie aktiv mit.
 Die Arsipa Gruppe ist eine schnell wachsende, PE-backed Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich Health, Safety & Environment, unterstützt von Warburg Pincus. Mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden, 20+ Tochtergesellschaften und 90 Standorten in Deutschland und Österreich bauen wir im Rahmen einer klaren Buy-&-Build-Strategie eine skalierbare Plattform mit nachhaltiger Wertschöpfung. Unser Ziel: eine der führenden Anbieterinnen im deutschsprachigen Markt - unterstützt durch zentrale Funktionen wie Finance, People, Marketing und IT am Standort Berlin.
 Deine Aufgaben:
 Datenplattform & Architektur
 Den Aufbau, Betrieb und die Weiterentwicklung unserer skalierbaren Datenplattform auf Basis moderner Warehouse-, Data-Lake- oder Lakehouse-Architekturen verantwortest Du eigenständig.
 Robuste ETL- und ELT-Pipelines zur Integration unterschiedlicher Datenquellen entwickelst, optimierst und wartest Du kontinuierlich.
 Moderne Datenarchitekturen und Datenmodelle gestaltest Du mit Blick auf Performance, Skalierbarkeit und eine effiziente Verarbeitung großer Datenmengen.
 Bestehende Datenarchitekturen analysierst und optimierst Du hinsichtlich Stabilität, Wirtschaftlichkeit und zukünftiger Anforderungen.

title: Data Engineer Intern
description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots.
 Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment.
 Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry.
 About the role
 The MLOps team at Gravis builds the data flow that turns raw recordings from our autonomous earthmoving machines (LiDAR point clouds, camera images, GNSS positions and hydraulic signals) into clean, searchable, training-ready datasets for our autonomy models.
 As an intern, you will learn how data moves through Gravis today, explore data pipeline tools and try the most promising ones on real fleet data, and have the opportunity to help build a pipeline that runs in production on our GPU clusters and is used by our ML and robotics engineers every day, with direct mentorship from senior engineers.
 We are looking for a motivated student or recent graduate with a background in computer science, data science or a related field and a solid foundation in Python and data processing, available to start in early 2027.
 What you will do
 Data pipeline
 Get to know how data is collected, stored, processed and labelled at Gravis today, map the current data flows, and suggest ways to improve them
 Explore the data pipeline and orchestration tools available today (e.g., Dagster, Flyte, Argo Workflows, Airflow, Ray Data) and compare them against our requirements: data volume, multimodal sensor data, CPU and GPU processing steps, reproducibility and ease of use
 Help build small prototypes of the most promising options and test them on real fleet data, from raw mac…

title: Data Engineer
description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.
 Discord is looking for a Data Engineer to join our Data Engineering team and help build the trusted data foundations that power decisions across the company. Data Engineering is the foundational layer between Discord's raw data and the teams that depend on it: Data Science, ML, Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders. You'll design, build, and maintain clean, tested, well-documented datasets that those teams can discover, trust, and self-serve from.
 You'll join one of two squads, Gaming or Ads , working alongside experienced data engineers and data scientists. This is a growth role: you'll take on well-scoped problems with guidance from senior teammates, and build toward owning a data domain end to end.
 If you enjoy data modeling, SQL, and making reliable data easy for other teams to use, read on.
 What You Will Be Doing
 Build and maintain well-modeled, tested, and documented datasets in BigQuery using dbt, with guidance from senior data engineers
 Take ownership of scoped pipelines, tables, and metric improvements within your squad, from requirements through delivery and documentation
 Write accurate, efficient SQL and Python to transform structured and unstructured data into curated datasets for analytics, experimentation, and ML
 Improve the reliability, freshness, and quality of existing datasets by adding tests, monitoring, and documentation
 Partner with data scientists, product managers, and engineers to turn clear requests into concrete data models, and ask good questions when requests are ambiguous
 Follow team standards for modeling, naming, version control, and CI/CD, and contrib…

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
Who we are
 About Privy
 Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. We build simple, flexible developer tooling that make it easy to build products that put users first. By leveraging modern cryptography, we shift the status quo around digital ownership and protect the accounts and assets of millions of users.
 Learn more about Privy: Privy and Stripe: Bringing crypto to everyone
 About the Team
 Data at Privy is not just about running queries or building reports. We transform messy, high-volume data into scalable systems and clear insights that guide product decisions and business strategy. We design pipelines that are resilient, models that are intuitive, and tools that make data accessible and trustworthy for everyone across the company. We believe in clean abstractions, transparency, and sharing our work so teammates can build on top of it. We push each other to ask sharper questions, test bold ideas, and follow the signal in the data so we can shape better products and empower our customers.
 What you’ll do
 In this role you’ll partner deeply with product, engineering, and GTM teams across Privy to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. You’ll work daily with partners across the Privy business to extract insights and build pipelines from the rich and complex Privy data set which is a unique combination of SaaS and blockchain data. You’ll build data products, metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards and reports to inform and run the business. You’ll deliver actionable business recommendations through analyses and data storytelling while also providing data infrastructure that allows users and stakeholders to self serve their own analyses.

title: Senior Data Engineer, Cloudforce One
description:
About Us
 At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
 At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
 Available Locations: London, UK
 About the role
 Cloudforce One is Cloudflare’s threat operations and research team, responsible for identifying and disrupting cyber threats ranging from sophisticated cyber criminal activity to nation-state sponsored advanced persistent threats (APTs). Members of Cloudforce One are at the helm of leveraging an incredibly vast and varied set of data points that only one of the world’s largest global networks can prov…

title: Data Engineer, Marketplace
description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.
 Here at Lyft, data is at the core of every decision we make. It powers our business — helping us create great transportation experiences for our customers and providing insights into the effectiveness of our product launches and features.
 As a Data Engineer on Lyft’s Marketplace – Decision Apps team, you will own and evolve the data pipelines that power our top-line financial, pricing, and driver-related metrics. You will collaborate with Analytics, Data Science, and Engineering partners to design data models and architectures — proposing innovative ideas, evaluating multiple approaches, and implementing solutions grounded in fundamental engineering principles and rigorous data analysis. Your work will provide seamless access to the insights that drive Lyft’s success.
 Responsibilities:
 Take ownership of core data pipelines, ensuring resilience, optimal performance, timely delivery, data quality, and seamless onboarding of new features
 Continuously evolve data models and schemas to meet business and engineering requirements
 Implement and maintain systems to monitor and enhance data quality and consistency
 Develop tools that support self-service management of data pipelines (ETL) and perform SQL tuning to optimize data processing performance
 Contribute to the Data Engineering team’s technical roadmap, ensuring alignment with team and stakeholder goals
 Write clean, well-tested, and maintainable code, prioritizing scalability and cost efficiency
 Conduct code reviews to uphold code quality standards and facilitate knowledge sharing
 Participate in on-call rotations to maintain high availability and reliability of workflows and data pipelines
 Collaborate with internal and external partners to remove blockers, provide support, and achieve results

title: Staff Data Engineer, Advanced Insights & Modeling
location: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
description:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.
Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.
 The Role
 The Advanced Insights and Modeling (AIM) team is a high-impact, business-savvy group of builders: machine learning engineers, data scientists, data engineers, and business strategists who combine technical skills with deep product and financial expertise. We hold high standards, move fast, and own our models end to end. AIM runs on curiosity, bold thinking, and collaboration, and we keep the culture decidedly non-corporate. Teams across Block come to us when they need insight, speed, and real business impact.
 AIM sits within Block’s Foundational organization and is sponsored directly by the CFO, but our mandate runs well beyond Finance. We own most of the measurement and predictive modeling at Block: forecasting across Cash App, Square, and Afterpay, customer lifetime value, marketing incrementality and spend optimization, sales pipeline and prospect value, and actives and network-effect measurement. Finance, Marketing, Sales, Product, and Risk all plan against numbers we produce. We also own the data foundations those models run on, and corporate functions inclu…
